description:
1824 - Norway Maple
Crown lift tree highway and street lamp clearance - Remove small branches over footpath at 3m to clear lightfall.
Overhangs footpath and road. Street lamp beneath crown.
Current height 12m, spread 9m.

1939 - Monterey Cypress
Crown lift tree highway and street lamp clearance To 2.5m over path.
Overhangs footpath.
Current height 12m, spread 7m.

1930 - Populus nigra
Section fell tree.
Twin stemmed recently pollarded and now regenerating. Large open buttress and low stem fracture on West aspect hence recent pollard to mitigate weight stress. Fracture width 3cm, not expanded since last inspection. Potential Ganoderma within.
Current height 12m, spread 9m.

0792nt - Japanese Cherry (Dead)
Straight fell tree.
Current height 4m, spread 2m.

- Following findings from a tree survey.
